description: Light-grey canvas; upper: framed board (ledge below) showing ocean cross-section: grey water, black seabed, deep V trench centre with white bubbly column and a tiny red dot at the trench bottom; lower-left: stick figure (round head) holding a sheet of paper in one hand. No text labels.
Label '<- PORTAL' (white text with arrow) appears at the trench bottom beside the red dot; nothing else changes.
Same board with '<- PORTAL' label at trench bottom; figure holding paper lower-left.
Two-line white label 'CHALLENGER DEEP' appears left of the trench bottom, beside PORTAL.
Board with labels 'CHALLENGER DEEP' and '<- PORTAL'; figure holding paper lower-left.
Stick figure redrawn: paper now hangs low at lower-left and the other hand is raised; board and both labels unchanged.
Board with CHALLENGER DEEP and PORTAL labels; figure lower-left with dropped paper and one hand raised.
Hard cut: board now white/empty with a thin black ground strip at the bottom labelled 'MARS'; figure now has both arms raised wide, dropped paper still lower-left.
Empty white board with black ground strip 'MARS'; figure arms raised wide, paper lower-left.
A red horizontal line appears near the top of the board, fully drawn in a single frame (write-on direction UNRESOLVED; looks like pop-on).
Board: red horizontal line near top, MARS ground strip at bottom; figure arms raised.
A small rover (black, with '!' above it) appears on the Mars ground strip at the centre.
Board: red line top, small rover with '!' centre on MARS ground; figure arms raised.
Grey vertical streaks (falling water curtain) appear hanging from the red line down to the ground, with spray at the base around the rover.

Board: grey water curtain from red line to Mars ground with splash and rover; figure arms raised. Hold has drift/encoder-artifact flags (frames 287-288), possibly slight texture shimmer; UNRESOLVED whether animated.
Hard cut to full-frame globe (grey ocean, white continents, Asia/Australia visible) with red dot, label 'MARIANA TRENCH PORTAL' and a small arrow; board and figure gone.
Globe with red dot and 'MARIANA TRENCH PORTAL' label and arrow; no character.
Stick figure appears at the bottom-left, hand at chin, with '...' above its head.
Globe with label; figure at bottom-left with '...'.
Hard cut to a flat grey background with a black-line basketball court drawing, a large red circle over the court and a red '20m' scale bar above it; globe and figure gone.
Grey background; basketball court with red circle and red '20m' bar above.

Hard cut to grey scene with many white radiating streaks over a black ground, a black whale silhouette arcing at centre-left, a second dark shape at centre-bottom, two small arc/umbrella-like objects left and right and a short red segment at the ground; fine detail unreadable at tile scale.
Same grey streak scene: whale silhouette, small objects, red segment at ground.

Hard cut to ocean cross-section: white sky top, black ground, grey water in a deep trench; white labels 'AVERAGE OCEAN DEPTH (3,700m / 12,000 ft)' (upper right) and 'CHALLENGER DEEP (10,935 m / 35,876 ft)' (lower) with arrows. Trench fill looks narrower than in the following hold; UNRESOLVED.
Cross-section with the two depth labels; grey water trench; white sky above.

Water surface line and label '-1cm/day' with a down arrow appear at the top centre of the trench; cross-section otherwise as before. The scene's vertical placement/scale also differs slightly from G0025 (labels lower); UNRESOLVED if a small camera shift occurred.

Cross-section with '-1cm/day', AVERAGE OCEAN DEPTH and CHALLENGER DEEP labels; trench grey fill wider than in G0026. Slow drift flag (D4, 29.4-36.5s) suggests a slow continuous shape change; UNRESOLVED.
White-outlined box appears lower-left on the black ground: 'TO DO / -ADD DRAINS / -ADD WHALE FILTER'.
Cross-section with labels plus lower-left white-outlined 'TO DO' list box.
Hard cut to flat world map (grey ocean, white land, black outline) in upper band with white label '0 m' above and red dot 'DRAIN' right; large white stick figure at lower-left on black.
World map band labelled '0 m' with red dot 'DRAIN'; white stick figure lower-left, arms down, on black.
Label changes '0 m' to '-50 m'; map ocean appears slightly shrunk; figure redrawn with one arm raised.
Map labelled '-50 m' with DRAIN; figure with raised arm lower-left.
Map enlarged and shifted (Europe/Africa/Asia in view), figure removed, 'DRAIN' label enlarged, red circle with 'GREAT BRITAIN' appears at upper left; '-50 m' label out of frame.
Zoomed map: red circle 'GREAT BRITAIN', 'DRAIN'; no figure.
Red circle and label 'SRI LANKA' appear at lower left of India; GREAT BRITAIN remains. Map framing looks slightly different (less zoomed) than G0035; UNRESOLVED.
Map with red circles GREAT BRITAIN and SRI LANKA, DRAIN.
Red circle and label 'NEW GUINEA' appear at right, lower area.
Map with red annotations GREAT BRITAIN, SRI LANKA, NEW GUINEA.
Red oval and label 'JAVA' appear left of New Guinea.
Map with red annotations GREAT BRITAIN, SRI LANKA, JAVA, NEW GUINEA.
Red circle and label 'BORNEO' appear above Java.
Map with five red annotations: GREAT BRITAIN, SRI LANKA, JAVA, BORNEO, NEW GUINEA.

Hard cut at 49.625s to white sky over black land with a central hill, tiny windmills right, small figure atop hill with label 'YOU CANNOT PASS!'; grey sea at left steadily drops over frames 1191-1271 (49.6-53.0s) to a thin sliver; label gone in the last sampled frame (1271). Intermediate frames only sampled every 16 frames.
Hill with tiny figure on top (no label), windmills right, white sky, water almost gone.
Hard cut back to flat world map band, '-50 m' label above, red dot 'DRAIN', white stick figure lower-left; red annotations absent and map at the original unzoomed framing.
Map '-50 m' with DRAIN; figure arms down lower-left. Hold has encoder artifact on last frame 1334.
Label '-50 m' dissolves to '-100 m' with ghosted overlapping digits over frames 1335-1340; map grey area recedes slightly.
Map '-100 m' with DRAIN; figure arms down.
Small red circle appears around the Black Sea area; figure redrawn with one arm raised.
Map '-100 m' with red circle at Black Sea; figure arm raised.
Label '-100 m' becomes '-200 m'; red circle gone; more shelf (light grey) land exposed on map; figure arms down.
Map '-200 m' with DRAIN; figure arms down.
Several tiny red arrows appear at scattered spots on the map (upper left, left, bottom); figure arm raised.
Map '-200 m' with small red arrows; figure arm raised.
Map enlarged on Africa/Asia/Indonesia; figure removed; large '-200 m' label upper left; large red circle around Indonesian archipelago and 'DRAIN'.
Zoomed map with big '-200 m', red circle around Indonesia, DRAIN; no figure.
Hand-lettered black 'THE NETHERLANDS' label with small arrow/mark appears over northern Europe.
Zoomed map with 'THE NETHERLANDS' label, Indonesia circle, '-200 m'; no figure.
7-frame cross-dissolve (frame 1637 shows both images overlaid) from the zoomed map to the unzoomed map; label becomes '-500 m' and figure returns lower-left with arm raised.
Unzoomed map '-500 m' with DRAIN; figure arm raised.
Map zoomed/shifted, figure kept; large '-500 m' label upper left; red circle around Japan/Korea area; DRAIN.
Zoomed map '-500 m' with red circle at Japan; figure arm raised.
Map back at unzoomed framing; label '-1000 m'; red circle gone; figure arms down.
Unzoomed map '-1000 m' with DRAIN; figure arms down.
Map shifted to the south-east Pacific; red circle and 'NEW ZEELAND' label at lower right; figure removed or out of frame; '-1000 m' label not visible.
Shifted map with red circle 'NEW ZEELAND' lower right; DRAIN; figure arms down lower-left.
Map reframed to the Atlantic/Americas; red curved arrow from 'OLD ZEELAND' (Europe side) to 'NEW-NEW ZEELAND' (North America); New Zealand circle gone.
Map with red curved arrow OLD ZEELAND to NEW-NEW ZEELAND; figure lower-left.
Map back at unzoomed framing, label '-5000 m'; land pattern changed with many darker grey patches (isolated basins) and light shelf area; figure arm raised.
Map '-5000 m' with darker grey basin patches and DRAIN; figure arm raised.
Label '-5000 m' becomes 'DRAINED'; map ocean patches changed again; figure arms down.
Map labelled 'DRAINED' with grey basin patches; figure arms down.
Figure redrawn with one arm raised; map unchanged.
Map 'DRAINED'; figure arm raised.
Several small red labels appear on the map, e.g. 'PUERTO RICO TRENCH' and 'SOUTH SANDWICH TRENCH'; others unreadable at tile scale.
Map 'DRAINED' with red trench labels (PUERTO RICO TRENCH, SOUTH SANDWICH TRENCH plus others unreadable); figure arm raised.
Hard cut to white sky and black silhouette landscape: hills left and right with windmills, small ships/buildings at right, shallow grey water pool in the central basin; no labels or figure.
Silhouette landscape with windmills and shallow grey water in the basin.

Hard cut to white canvas with framed TV: stick-figure reporter (ponytail, microphone), 'NEWS' tag, ticker 'NETHERLANDS FOUNDED NEW GIETHOORN'; text left: 'WHERE HAS THE WATER GONE?' and 'CONSPIRACY THEORISTS CLAIM IT'S ON MARS!' with a line to the reporter.
TV news frame with reporter, ticker and the two lines of speech text.
Hard cut to the opening-style framed board on white: black hill at left with a tiny stick figure on top, grey water at right, text 'HUH, WATER'.
Board with tiny figure on black hill, water at right, 'HUH, WATER'; white lower canvas empty.
